item.title: The Leak
item.description:
Had a serious leak tonight.

Tea went all over my desk.

Luckily most of it missed the keyboard, although a notebook took a direct hit and now several pages of operational notes are permanently brown.

This is why I never keep everything digital. You can’t hack paper. You can spill tea on it, apparently, but that’s a separate threat model.

I spent twenty minutes moving cables and wiping everything down. The computer stayed on through the whole incident, which proves the setup is more resilient than most corporate networks.

item.title: New Keyboard
item.description:
Finally replaced my keyboard today.

The old one was getting ridiculous. Half the keys needed to be hit twice and the space bar had developed this horrible squeak that made it sound like I was typing inside an old cupboard.

The new one is much quieter, which is nice because I tend to use my computer late at night.

Spent most of the afternoon setting everything up and moving things around on my desk. I also found a pile of receipts underneath my monitor that I have apparently been ignoring for several months.
